name: Building 15, timber shed (twin of Building 16)

shape_note: NRHP: construction began 1939 for the battleship programme (800 ft x 100 ft, single bay, welding facilities and mold loft); start 1940 and end 1980 are estimated (demolished, no date found); outline traced from the 1946 plan (NRHP Map #15) registered to the standing buildings, +-10 m; height estimated.

name: Building Ways No. 2 (Connecticut ways, west slip)
shape_note: NRHP: Building Ways No. 2 built 1917 (the Indiana, keel 1920); extended 1937-39; "demolished" (no date): end 1970 is estimated; outline from the 1946 plan, +-12 m (an open slipway, not a roofed building); height estimated.

name: Building Ways No. 1 (Connecticut ways, east slip)
shape_note: NRHP: Building Ways No. 1 removed and rebuilt 1903 for the Connecticut (the Maine, 1890, was launched on the earlier ways); end 1970 estimated (demolished, no date); outline from the 1946 plan, +-12 m; height estimated.

name: Building 4, structural shop (later mold loft)
shape_note: NRHP: structural shop of ca. 1918-19 (Building 4, demolished; the name passed to the 1944 gun shed); start estimated within 1917-19, end 1980 estimated (no date); outline traced from the 1946 plan, +-12 m; height estimated.

name: Building 294, sub-assembly shop
